      allocate(this%par(n),this%rnk(n),this%siz(n))
    end if
    this%n = n

    this%siz = 1
    this%par = [(i,i=1,n)]
  end
  subroutine releaseuf(this)
    class(union_find), intent(inout) :: this
    if (this%n /= 0) deallocate(this%par,this%rnk,this%siz)
    this%n = 0
  end

    class(union_find), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: ret
    if (this%par(i) /= i) this%par(i) = find(this,this%par(i))
    ret = this%par(i)
  end

    integer, intent(in) :: i, j

    end if
  end

  end

    class(t_queue), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: item
    type(t_node), pointer :: node

    node => new_node(item)
    if (associated(this%head)) then
      node%prev => this%tail
      this%tail%next => node
    else
      this%head => node
    end if
    this%tail => node
    this%num = this%num+1
  end

    class(t_queue), intent(inout) :: this
    integer :: item
    type(t_node), pointer :: node

    node => this%head%next

    this%head => node
    if (associated(node)) then
      node%prev => null()
    else
      this%tail => null()
    end if
    this%num = this%num-1
  end

    class(t_queue), intent(in) :: this
    integer :: item

  end

    type(t_node), pointer :: node, next

    node => this%head
    do while (associated(node%next))
      next => node%next
      deallocate(node)
      node => next
    end do
    this%head => null()
    this%tail => null()
    this%num = 0
  end

type UnionFind = object

proc newUnionFind(size:int):UnionFind =
  var uf:UnionFind
  uf.data = newSeqWith(size,-1)

proc compress(uf:var UnionFind,x:int,r:var int):void =

  uf.compress(uf.data[x],r)
  uf.data[x] = r;

  var

    ry = uf.root(y)
  if rx != ry:
    if uf.data[ry] < uf.data[rx]:
      swap(rx, ry)
    uf.data[rx] += uf.data[ry]
    uf.data[ry] = rx
  return rx != ry;

  return uf.root(x) == uf.root(y)

proc solve(N:int, M:int, Q:int, A:seq[int], B:seq[int], C:seq[int]) =

    if vis[r]: continue
    vis[r] = true
    roots.add(r)
    max_s = max(s,max_s)
    if s == 2:
      two_ct += 1
    elif s >= 2:
      emin += s
      emax += s * (s - 1) div 2
  var

      uf2.unionSet(A[i],B[i])

  var
